justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/ByteOrderParser.java` and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/ByteOrderParserTest.java`. The class is only 66 lines, has one public API method (`parseByteOrder`) plus a private constructor, and implements a single cohesive responsibility: converting two `ByteOrder` string constants into enum values or throwing `IllegalArgumentException`. The test class covers only those three behaviors, which supports that this class is small and not insufficiently modularized.
